output_list.criticism: The initialSupply is added to the balanceOf[target] without a check, causing a potential overflow if initialSupply is very large.
The balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value; statement can underflow if _value is larger than balanceOf[msg.sender], causing a buyout of the balanceOf[msg.sender].
The balanceOf[_from] -= _value; statement can underflow if _value is larger than balanceOf[_from], causing a buyout of the balanceOf[_from].
The balanceOf[msg.sender] -= amount; statement can underflow if amount is larger than balanceOf[msg.sender], causing a buyout of the balanceOf[msg.sender].
The amount is set to msg.value / buyPrice without a check, causing a potential overflow if buyPrice is very small.
